RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, meaning sex was not a factor in choosing between you. Raising the panel's gender composition in the context of your non-selection would appear unfounded, undermine your professional credibility, and damage relationships within the organization. 

While an all-male panel may reflect broader diversity or governance shortcomings within the broadcaster's recruitment practices, it does not evidence bias against you as a male applicant. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting your interview feedback. The appointment was explicitly justified by "strong experience of digital media," suggesting the panel prioritized modern platform expertise over traditional tenure. Keep all future communications focused strictly on objective qualifications and constructive feedback.
